response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but his background is almost entirely web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Ember) rather than embedded networking security. The role has two hard requirements he does not meet: native-level Japanese proficiency (his listed languages are English, Romanian, and basic German) and demonstrable C development on UNIX with Linux kernel source analysis/modification — his C/C++ exposure is limited to a brief 2014-2015 LabWindows/CVI stint and a bachelor thesis. There is no evidence of MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, L2/L3 switching, NETCONF/SNMP, chip-vendor SDKs, or switch firmware work. Despite strong general engineering credentials, the gap to this specialized position is too large.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded/hardware projects
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling authorship, and DevOps/build-environment setup
Some C/C++ background (National Instruments LabWindows/CVI) plus Linux and low-latency systems work
concerns: No Japanese language ability listed; role requires native-level proficiency
No demonstrated Linux kernel analysis/modification or recent professional C on UNIX
Zero evident networking-security or LAN-switch domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3, SNMP/NETCONF)

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded networking/security domain experience
Weak recent C / Linux kernel depth
